research_scope: Punisher Shield — Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill.

verification_audit.method: Compared current repository coverage with Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation, Dragon Ball reference material, community mechanics discussion, and the established Counter Skills taxonomy.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No prior repository research batch for Punisher Shield was found. The canonical identity is Super / Ki Blast; counter behavior is represented through the Counter Skills taxonomy.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Punisher Shield as a Ki Blast Super and Universal Counter. It creates a barrier that can reflect incoming Ki Blasts and triggers a follow-up kick when the opponent or their Ki Blast touches the barrier.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Punisher Shield is obtainable from Parallel Quest 129 — Frieza Force on the Hunt.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: The skill was introduced with Extra Pack 4 and is associated with SSGSS Gogeta.
verification_audit.finish_policy: The reviewed evidence establishes PQ129 as the acquisition quest but does not establish an explicit Ultimate Finish requirement for the skill. Therefore ultimate_finish_required remains null rather than being inferred.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100. No reliable reviewed source establishes a stamina cost or drop probability, so those fields remain null.
verification_audit.availability_policy: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies Future Warrior as a user of the technique in Xenoverse 2. This supports usable_by_cac true.

records.name: Punisher Shield
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 129 — Frieza Force on the Hunt
records.skill_description: Generate a barrier that stops an opponent's Ki Blast and launches one back at them; when the opponent or their Ki Blast touches the barrier, a follow-up kick is performed.
records.mechanics_notes: The barrier persists for about two seconds according to the Xenoverse 2 skill reference. A Ki Blast contacting the barrier is reflected and followed by a teleporting kick. The same kick can trigger when an opponent touches the barrier at close range. The reviewed reference reports approximately 7% total damage for the sequence. Community discussion corroborates use against both rushing opponents and incoming Ki attacks, but exact frame behavior is not promoted to canonical data.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ129, Frieza Force on the Hunt, is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route. The exact random reward probability is unresolved.
records.pve_notes: PQ129 is the documented farming route. No Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded because the reviewed evidence does not explicitly establish one.
records.pvp_notes: The barrier can function as a defensive counter against both incoming Ki Blasts and opponents entering its space. Community reports describe utility during rushes and combos; exact matchup/frame data is version-sensitive.
